summary: Unconditionally normalizes a 4-component float vector using a Newton-Raphson refined reciprocal square root. Computes the squared length of the input a2 over all four components, computes v6 = 1/sqrt(v5), applies the refinement v7 = (dword_5D8A40 - v5*v6*v6) * dword_5D8A30 * v6, scales every input component by v7 into the output a1, and returns a1. No threshold guard.

local_names.v5: squared length of the input vector
local_names.v7: Newton-Raphson refinement scale applied to every component

operations.description: Compute the squared length v5 = a2[0]*a2[0] + a2[1]*a2[1] + a2[2]*a2[2] + a2[3]*a2[3]
Compute v6 = 1.0 / fsqrt(v5), the reciprocal square root of the squared length
Newton-Raphson refinement: v7 = (dword_5D8A40 - v5 * v6 * v6) * dword_5D8A30 * v6
Scale every input component by v7 into the output vector: a1[0] = a2[0]*v7, a1[1] = a2[1]*v7, a1[2] = a2[2]*v7, a1[3] = a2[3]*v7
Return the output vector pointer a1
